purpose: issue #23 K1 baseline before any K1 change

build-cuda: ./scripts/with-msvc.ps1 nvcc -O2 -arch=native -Isrc -Ithird_party/random123/include build\main_cuda.obj build\codec_cuda.obj build\quantizer_cuda_host.obj build\rng_cpu_cuda.obj build\quantizer_cuda.obj -o build\mco2.exe

toolkit_and_driver.c_compiler: Microsoft (R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version 19.51.36260 for x64

rules.peak: theoretical_peak_gbps = 2 * memory_clock_khz * 1e3 * bus_width_bits / 8 / 1e9 (DDR convention, CUDA C++ Best Practices Guide); the RTX 5060 vendor figure is 448 GB/s (28 Gbps x 128-bit GDDR7)
rules.effective: effective_gbps = K1_INPUT_READS * 4 * count / k1 pooled median (ms) / 1e6; the contract forces two full input reads (max|x|, then the squared terms)
rules.regime: dram when 4 * count >= 4 * L2 size, transitional when 4 * count > L2 size, else l2-resident; fractions, headroom and the probe ceiling use dram sizes only

protocol.order: cells shuffled per process round, random.Random(23)

initial_gpu_warm_up.workload: cuda resident, 8-bit, input_n67108864, 100 reps per process
